//: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json, token.txt and app_secret.txt are git-ignored.
//verify_token: Any long random string; typed again in the Meta app's webhook settings.
//token_file: The access token, alone on the first line. The greeting script's file works.
//app_secret_file: Meta app -> App settings -> Basic -> App secret, alone on the first line.
//alert_numbers: Told on WhatsApp about every new message, e.g. ["9701491148"]. Empty: no alerts.
//alert_template: Optional utility template with two body slots (who, what) for alerts after 24 hours.
//send_logs: The greeting script's log, so its sends show up in the chats.
//access: Cloudflare Zero Trust team name and the Access application's AUD tag. Both set: checked here too.
//privacy_contact: Printed on the public privacy page, e.g. an email address. Empty: 'us on this WhatsApp number'.
